title: Venice
subtitle: The Floating City
summary: Our Mediterranean adventure began in Venice, where canals replaced roads and centuries of history appeared around every corner. Arriving by private water taxi gave us an unforgettable introduction to a city best experienced slowly—from its grand waterways and ornate architecture to its quiet lanes and evenings beside the water.
heroImageAlt: Water taxi crossing a vivid turquoise canal between historic Venetian buildings
homepageSummary: Begin our adventure in Venice with a water-taxi arrival, winding canals, quiet alleyways, unforgettable meals, and timeless beauty.

sections.heading: Arriving by Water
paragraphs: After landing in Venice, everything about travel suddenly changed. Roads disappeared, boats replaced cars, and our private water taxi became the first chapter of an adventure we had dreamed about for months.

As we cruised through the canals toward our hotel, historic buildings rose directly from the water and gondolas quietly passed beneath centuries-old bridges. Within minutes, we realized Venice wasn't simply another city—it was an experience unlike anywhere else in the world.
sections.imageAlt: Dianne seated inside a private water taxi crossing the Venetian lagoon
sections.imageCaption: Our Venice adventure began on the water

sections.heading: Getting Lost on Purpose
paragraphs: Some of our favorite memories came without an itinerary. We wandered through quiet alleyways, crossed countless bridges, and discovered charming canals where very few tourists seemed to venture.
Every turn revealed another postcard view. Small cafés, colorful buildings, flower-filled balconies, and peaceful canals reminded us that Venice rewards those willing to slow down and simply explore.
sections.imageAlt: A quiet Venice canal glowing in warm late-afternoon light
sections.imageCaption: Golden light along one of Venice's quieter canals

sections.heading: The Art of Lingering
paragraphs: Our evenings quickly became our favorite part of Venice. Sitting outside along the canals, enjoying incredible Italian food while gondolas quietly drifted past, created memories that photographs could never fully capture.
It wasn't just the scenery that made Venice special. It was sharing those moments together—the conversations, the laughter, and the realization that this incredible journey was only beginning.
sections.imageAlt: Tables arranged beneath warm lights in a quiet Venetian courtyard
sections.imageCaption: A tucked-away courtyard ready for the evening

sections.heading: Beauty in Every Detail
paragraphs: Venice rewarded us whenever we remembered to look up. Beyond the canals were graceful courtyards, richly decorated interiors, weathered facades, and architectural details shaped by generations of artists and craftspeople.

That contrast became part of the city's magic: a quiet brick alley could open into an elegant square, while an unassuming doorway could reveal a room glowing with color and gold. Venice felt less like a collection of landmarks and more like one continuous work of art.

sections.imageCaption: Venice's artistry rewards a closer look

highlights.title: Grand Canal
highlights.description: Venice's main waterway serves as both a transportation route and one of the city's most beautiful sightseeing experiences.

highlights.title: St. Mark's Square
highlights.description: The historic heart of Venice, surrounded by remarkable architecture, cafés, and centuries of history.

highlights.title: Hidden Canals
highlights.description: Some of Venice's greatest beauty is found away from the crowds in its quiet residential neighborhoods.

highlights.title: Canal-side Dining
highlights.description: Sharing authentic Italian meals beside the canals became one of our favorite parts of every evening.

tips.title: Walk beyond the tourist areas
tips.description: Some of Venice's most memorable streets and canals are found just a few blocks away from the busiest attractions.

tips.title: Travel by water taxi at least once
tips.description: Arriving by boat provides an unforgettable first impression of Venice.

tips.title: Slow down
tips.description: Venice is best experienced without rushing. Leave time simply to wander and discover.

tips.title: Enjoy dinner along the canals
tips.description: Evening meals beside the water offer some of the most memorable moments of the entire city.

reflections.author: Dianne
reflections.title: From Dianne's Journal
reflections.text: The moment our water taxi entered the canals, I knew this trip was going to be something special. Venice felt magical from the very beginning.

reflections.author: Steve
reflections.title: Steve's Notes
reflections.text: I've seen thousands of photographs of Venice, but none of them prepared me for what it felt like to stand there in person. The city somehow feels both timeless and alive.

quote.text: The moment we stepped onto the water taxi, we realized this wasn't just another vacation—it was the beginning of an adventure.
